svg.text: STAGE 452 · TOPIC 92 · SVG 96 · 🎉 HISTORIC 455-DIMENSION MILESTONE (P897–P898)
Enterprise WebRTC RFC 8831 / RFC 8832 SCTP DataChannel Glare & PR-SCTP Guard
Eliminating DCEP Even/Odd Stream-ID Glare, SCTP PPID Type Confusion & 50Hz Caption Backpressure Stalls
🎉 455 EVALUATION DIMENSIONS
907 Guards · 916 Probes · 894 Tests
❌ Unguarded DataChannel: Stream-ID Glare & Caption HoL Stall
1. RFC 8832 Even/Odd Stream-ID Glare & PPID Type Confusion
• Gateway ignores DTLS Server role and allocates even Stream-ID (0, 2).
• Collides with browser DTLS Client even Stream-ID → interleaves tool
JSON and ASR transcripts on the same stream! Plus mid-stream PPID=50
re-open or invalid PPID51/56 padding crashes JSON parser!
Result: Cross-Channel JSON Corruption & PPID Deserialization Crash
2. RFC 8831 Reliable-Ordered Caption Stall & Buffer Exhaustion
• 50Hz interim ASR captions sent over 0x00 Reliable-Ordered channel.
• Single Wi-Fi loss stalls urgent barge-in cancellation for 180–350ms.
• Retransmit backlog inflates bufferedAmount past 16MB ceiling,
triggering SCTP ABORT and tearing down the entire control plane!
Result: 350ms Barge-In Control Freeze & SCTP Association Teardown
✅ RFC 8832 Parity Guard (P897) & PR-SCTP TTL Guard (P898)
P897 · RFC 8832 DTLS Even/Odd Parity, PPID & [1, 64]-Stream Guard
• Enforces DTLS Client = Even (0,2,4) & DTLS Server = Odd (1,3,5) IDs.
• Strict PPID {50, 51, 53, 56, 57} validation; blocks mid-stream PPID=50.
• Clamps concurrent DataChannel streams per session to [1, 64].
• 100% eliminates DCEP Stream-ID glare & PPID type-confusion crashes!
clampedStreamIdGlareOrPpidConfusedChunks = 0 · Streams ∈ [1, 64]
P898 · RFC 8831 PR-SCTP [100, 1000]ms TTL & Control Isolation Guard
• Isolates barge-in/tool JSON on dedicated reliable Stream 0.
• Routes 50Hz interim captions to PR-SCTP (0x82) with maxPacketLifeTime
clamped to [100, 1000]ms (250ms nominal) + FORWARD-TSN skip.
• Zero barge-in stalls & zero bufferedAmount SCTP ABORT teardowns!
clampedBufferedAmountOverflowOrStalledControlChannels = 0 · TTL ∈ [100, 1000]ms
